summary: Round-1 SPEC-1 is fixed for issue-add, but the fix makes ledger-add's cross-call dedupe drop genuine repeat overruns, so FR-004's stall cap still cannot halt on the primary deadline-stop path.

findings.summary: FR-004/FR-002: ledger-add dedupe on (stage, role, commit, 'overrun') now matches every repeat overrun because commit is the stable last work commit, so repeat partial-return overruns are dropped and the stall cap never reaches 3.
findings.evidence: ENG-1, ENG-19, FR-004, FR-006. Line 859 append_issue(s, issue, dedupe=(stage, role, issue.get("commit"), "overrun")). overrun_issue (918) now uses worktree_work_commit. Repro in Sandbox worktree: three ledger-add implement code-build --overrun ... --partial-return gave consecutive_no_commit 1,1,1, halt false, state.issues held 1 record. SKILL.md 158-159 route every deadline stop through this command. New tests only exercise issue-add.
findings.fix: Remove cross-call dedupe in cmd_ledger_add (append_issue(s, issue)) or key on spawn identity (started_at/ended_at). Test three ledger-add --overrun --partial-return calls -> halt true on third and three issues; work commit between resets.
